page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by the KVM hypervisor on the x86_64 architecture. The server is provisioned with 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz. System memory totals 30.0 GB, providing an allocation of 3.75 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance features a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile and contains no local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for persistent data.

Benchmark data reflects strong specialized acceleration alongside consistent general-purpose compute metrics. General CPU evaluations, including Geekbench (1580 single-core, 5901 multi-core) and PassMark CPU (11,364.98), register within the average benchmark tiers. Similarly, system memory bandwidth reaches 57.43 GB/sec on uncached large-block reads and 38.52 GB/sec on writes. In contrast, the dedicated NVIDIA A10 GPU yields top-tier results in machine learning inference tasks, delivering 9,665.83 prompt tokens per second and 456.78 generation tokens per second on small 135M parameter models, as well as 2,504.89 prompt tokens per second and 90.71 generation tokens per second on 7B parameter models.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the instance balances mid-tier dedicated host compute with a workstation-class accelerator. By pairing 8 vCPUs and 30 GB of RAM with an A10 GPU, the configuration avoids resource overhead typical of multi-GPU systems while preserving substantial graphics and tensor throughput. The absence of local disk requires external block storage planning, which introduces potential I/O latency tradeoffs depending on storage configuration.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c8g1.2xlarge is suited for machine learning inference on small to mid-sized language models, real-time video processing, graphics rendering, and GPU-accelerated computing workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for compute and graphics workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization, it features 8 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, paired with 30.0 GB of system memory. Hardware acceleration is provided by one NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. Networking operates with a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and the server provides no bundled local storage. Benchmarks place the system's central processing and memory throughput in the middle performance tiers, while GPU-driven inference tasks achieve top-tier ratings, reaching 2,504.89 prompt tokens per second on 7B models. This architecture offers balanced resource allocation for inference workloads without the operational overhead of multi-GPU instances. The instance fits small-to-medium LLM serving, computer vision processing, and rendering pipelines.
